question: The diagram shows 3 blocks in contact on a smooth surface. A 162N force acts on block 1 from the left, and the surface can be considered frictionless. Calculate:
question_parts: The net force on each block
The contact forces for each block
answer_parts: The acceleration of the system is 9ms^-2
Each block has an acceleration of 9ms^-2

Block 1 has a net force of 81N
Block 2 has a net force of 27N
Block 3 has a net force of 54N

Block 1 has 2 forces acting on it. They are: 162N Applied force, -81N Contact (from Block 2) force
Block 2 has 2 forces acting on it. They are: 81N Contact (from Block 1) force, -54N Contact (from Block 3) force
Block 3 has 1 force acting on it. They are: 54N Contact (from Block 2) force
